scope: Independent static source and saved-receipt review of the new native UDM partial-activation fixture. No raw scientific arrays, compiler, model, or RTE were run by reviewer.

source_semantics.activation_block: At module_mp_udm.F:2527-2539, RH>1 selects activation; alpha=min(1,exp(log((RH-1)/satmax)*actk)); NC_ACT=max(0,((NN+NC)*alpha-NC))*rdt then capped by max(NN,0)*rdt; PC_ACT is the embryo-mass rate capped by max(QV,0)*rdt. Updates are source-ordered to QV/QC, NN/NC and T.
source_semantics.manual_oracle: The final v5 oracle mirrors the native left-associated PC_ACT numerator and denominator, checks the source NC_ACT equation and branch targets, checks activation temperature and unassigned state, and permits only a declared REAL32/libm relative bound for the exp/log mass-rate reconstruction. It requires strict partial alpha and positive NC_ACT.
source_semantics.warm_partial_cf_timing: CF is diagnosed at cldf_diag and recorded before the in-cloud divide (1096-1112); the source restores condensate arrays to grid mean (1303-1311) before activation begins (2512 onward). The observer captures closure, divide/restore, activation, and radius-helper stages. The fixture uses warm T=285 K and observed CF about 0.58005 with target alpha 0.35/0.65.
source_semantics.cap_floor_checks: The checker verifies the pre-CF number adjustment is unchanged across its bracket, activation NN-rate cap and vapor-mass cap are strictly inactive, CCN and cloud-number floors are not reached, and the resulting NC remains below the configured NC ceiling. Forced-floor and nonpartial-alpha mutations are rejected. This applies to selected activation conditions, not every limiter in every UDM process.
source_semantics.density_and_units: Two EOS-consistent dry-density arms share temperature, target RH, and raw number inputs. The receipt explicitly disclaims number-population unit authority and PSD/LUT equivalence.

pr152_ci_context.scope_note: This saved terminal record ties the 11 checks to merged PR152 head 59697ca and main d87cd50 tree. It is not evidence that the new partial-activation test itself has already passed on a later commit.

nonblocking_test_hardening.finding: The analyzer requires 0<CF_IN<1 and separately records ACT_PRE.cf as preceding_closure_cf, but it does not explicitly assert CF_IN.cf == ACT_PRE.cf. The pinned source has no intervening cldf assignment between cldf_diag and activation, so current sequence supports the interpretation; a direct equality gate would make the temporal join regression-proof.

overall_limits: Direct outer UDM test fixture; no host producer/storage/transport/restart path.
No authority for number concentration units or population conversion.
No independent liquid/ice/snow LUT or PSD/moment validation.
No WRF forecast, MPI, RTE, or full host integration.
The seven existing physical gates retain their prior OPEN/FAIL/NOT_RUN status.
